frameConvention: Zero-based local decoded frame; endpoints inclusive. Source frames are preserved separately.
eventMethod: Visual inspection of consecutive original crop frames. Landing brackets the descending forefoot approaching the surface and sustained support. Release brackets the last hand/ball overlap and visibly separated ball. Occlusion and repeated frames widen intervals. These are provisional image-event brackets, not force contact or independently validated ball-release labels.
selection: Seven accessible, automatically linked fastballs/sliders from one game and center-field live view, selected to exercise a multi-pitch workflow. Convenience pilot, not a random or representative player sample. Other views and games remain unaudited.
